test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
**Direction: **Study the following information carefully to answer the questions given below-

Six persons T, O, Y, L, B and F are sitting around a circular table facing outside the center not necessarily in the same order. Y is not an immediate neighbour of T. O sits between T and B who sits second left of L.

Who sits immediate left of O?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) O sits between T and B who sits second left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e97a3641a0031d60f6f760be02ab7315a7cc785e8ddb416f12511ebb0846382b.png] 

2) Y is not an immediate neighbour of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b075110d9fa89dbc4dc7bcb51b425d77df002df32dbcf0aa28a4060f18942080.png] 

Hence, T sits immediate left of O.
